US ONET tasks for Appraisers and Assessors of Real Estate can be understood in four groups. Information checks and property inspections: search public records for sale, rental, and assessment information; verify ownership, registration, and legal descriptions; consult building codes and zoning ordinances; inspect properties and new and remodeled construction; photograph interiors and exteriors and draw parcel maps; and interview contractors, owners, and agents. Market research and data organization: collect and analyze sale prices, construction costs, rents, and vacancy rates; identify local real estate market trends; check property transfer information and correct errors; and assess effects on value from parcels, neighborhoods, nearby schools, businesses, parks, and other amenities. Value calculation and reports: select and apply the sales comparison, income, and cost approaches; estimate replacement costs and depreciation; analyze income and operating expenses of income-producing properties; calculate final value conclusions; prepare written appraisal reports under appraisal standards; and testify in court. Tax assessment and administration: establish ownership of taxable property; create and maintain parcel records, boundary maps, land and building inventories, and exemption information; determine property taxability; establish a fair, uniform assessment system; calculate taxes as assessed value multiplied by the tax rate; explain assessed values to owners; and respond to assessment appeals at public hearings.

entries: Information checks and ownership verification | Clarify basic information before work | Search public records for sale, rental, and assessment information, obtain county land values and nearby property sales, check and correct property transfer information, and compare legal descriptions item by item with county registration records to ensure accuracy of the property and ownership scope.

Property inspections and evidence recording | Document site facts | Inspect property location, structure, and surroundings using inspection checklists; examine new and substantially remodeled construction; photograph interiors and exteriors; draw parcel maps and floor plan sketches; interview contractors, owners, and agents to supplement information; and check effects of building codes and zoning ordinances on value.

Market research and data analysis | Support judgments with data | Collect and analyze sale prices, construction costs, rents, and vacancy rates; identify local real estate market trends; examine parcels, neighborhoods, nearby schools, businesses, parks, and other amenities; and analyze income and operating expense records of income-producing properties.

Value calculation and report preparation | Produce reviewable conclusions under standards | Select and apply the sales comparison, income, and cost approaches, estimate replacement costs and depreciation while considering comparable sales and income potential, calculate final value conclusions, and prepare written reports under appraisal standards explaining methods and evidence. Testify in court on value when necessary.

Tax assessment and records management | Establish a uniform, fair assessment system | Establish ownership of taxable property and maintain boundary maps, land and building inventories, characteristics, and exemption information parcel by parcel. Determine taxability through inspections, structural measurements, calculations, sales, and market trend analysis, and establish a uniform, practical assessment system for different property types.

Tax calculation and public communication | Make conclusions explainable and open to appeal | Calculate taxes as assessed value multiplied by the jurisdiction's tax rate, explain assessed values and real and personal property taxes to owners, and present evidence and respond to assessment appeals at public hearings.

Day 2 | Occupational and legal boundaries
Read legal sources and US tasks, listing different authority for assistants, engagement-handling professionals, registered appraisers, and US local assessors.
Day 3 | Value estimate explanation exercise
Use the complete fictional residential exercise to list valuation date, area conflict, assumptions, and a checklist of items to verify. Do not supplement data with actual property listings.
Day 4 | Comparable case adjustment exercise
Complete the A/B/C unit price, factor, and weight table, explain why D is unused, and recalculate conditional amounts and differences for 98/100 m².
Day 5 | Income-approach calculation exercise
Use only the commercial exercise assumptions to calculate effective rent 216000, NOI 156000, and sensitivity at 5/6/7%. Do not present this as a cash flow model.
Day 6 | Write an owner explanation
Draft the exercise owner reply in ≤500 characters, without using an institution's name. Check figures, unknowns, and review steps against the reference answer.
Day 7 | Review and decide

Review willingness to inspect, recalculate, retain records, and communicate. The four outputs are a requirement matrix, residential table/explanation, income calculations, and a reply. Record actual qualifications and job conditions awaiting checks.

entries: After completing a week of preparation, first ask: am I willing to commit to information checks and recalculation over the long term, and maintain truthful explanations and records when conclusions are challenged or even enter appeals or litigation?
Judge direction: residential appraisal, commercial and income-producing property appraisal, tax assessment and appeals, or dispute and litigation support.

Judge preparation: whether education and professional training, real estate appraiser examination and registration requirements, practical experience, data and spreadsheet tool skills, and compliance and confidentiality training are met or can be developed.

Article 8 of the Asset Appraisal Law distinguishes appraisers from other appraisal professionals with professional knowledge and practical experience; do not describe all assistants as requiring an appraiser certificate. Article 13 requires verification and confidentiality of information and recusal for conflicts of interest; disclosure cannot replace recusal. Articles 24/27 require at least two professionals to handle an engagement, signatures by two handling professionals, and the institution's seal. Article 28 requires statutory appraisals to be signed by at least two appraisers in the corresponding specialty with the seal. Individuals must not issue reports under an institution's name without authority.

Judge tolerance: ability to adapt to property inspections and travel intensity (43% exposed outdoors daily, 48% inside enclosed vehicles daily), workweeks and schedules (70% work more than 40 hours, 75% have irregular schedules), high accuracy requirements (67% consider exactness or accuracy extremely important), and competition (35% high, 39% moderate).

Continually organizing value estimate explanations, adjustment tables, and owner explanations into checkable preparation materials is more reliable than trusting unofficial promises.

Those holding the specified real estate/land appraiser certificates before implementation may be exempt from the corresponding subject and pass the remaining three within 3 consecutive years; not everyone has 4 years. Under Article 16, qualification and registration permit work in real estate and land appraisal under the real estate appraiser title and signing of corresponding reports.

Article 8 of the Asset Appraisal Law distinguishes appraisers from other appraisal professionals with professional knowledge and practical experience; do not describe all assistants as requiring an appraiser certificate. Articles 24/27 require at least two professionals to handle an engagement, signatures by two handling professionals, and the institution's seal. Article 28 requires statutory appraisals to be signed by at least two appraisers in the corresponding specialty with the seal. Individuals must not issue reports under an institution's name without authority.

entries.answer: Article 10 of China's Jian Fang Gui [2021] No. 3 sets examination application conditions including support for the Party's leadership and the socialist system, compliance with the Constitution and laws, good professional competence, moral character and conduct, and a college diploma or higher; education alone is insufficient. The examination has four subjects, with 4 consecutive years for candidates taking all subjects. Those holding the specified real estate/land appraiser certificates before implementation may be exempt from the corresponding subject and pass the remaining three within 3 consecutive years; not everyone has 4 years. Under Article 16, qualification and registration permit work in real estate and land appraisal under the real estate appraiser title and signing of corresponding reports. Article 13 requires verification and confidentiality of information and recusal for conflicts of interest; disclosure cannot replace recusal. Articles 24/27 require at least two professionals to handle an engagement, signatures by two handling professionals, and the institution's seal. Article 28 requires statutory appraisals to be signed by at least two appraisers in the corresponding specialty with the seal. Individuals must not issue reports under an institution's name without authority. facts.display_value: Article 10 of China's Jian Fang Gui [2021] No. 3 sets examination application conditions including support for the Party's leadership and the socialist system, compliance with the Constitution and laws, good professional competence, moral character and conduct, and a college diploma or higher; education alone is insufficient. The examination has four subjects, with 4 consecutive years for candidates taking all subjects. Those holding the specified real estate/land appraiser certificates before implementation may be exempt from the corresponding subject and pass the remaining three within 3 consecutive years; not everyone has 4 years. Under Article 16, qualification and registration permit work in real estate and land appraisal under the real estate appraiser title and signing of corresponding reports. Article 8 of the Asset Appraisal Law distinguishes appraisers from other appraisal professionals with professional knowledge and practical experience; do not describe all assistants as requiring an appraiser certificate. Article 13 requires verification and confidentiality of information and recusal for conflicts of interest; disclosure cannot replace recusal. Articles 24/27 require at least two professionals to handle an engagement, signatures by two handling professionals, and the institution's seal. Article 28 requires statutory appraisals to be signed by at least two appraisers in the corresponding specialty with the seal. Individuals must not issue reports under an institution's name without authority. Evidence gap: this round did not verify registration application materials, institutional recruitment and training duration, US state/local rules, or the specific 2022 occupational classification entry locality by locality. Qualification legal sources provide no nationwide hiring shares and do not establish driving, medical examinations, or criminal record certificates as uniform thresholds for all positions.
